paper.title: EvolveMem:Self-Evolving Memory Architecture via AutoResearch for LLM Agents
paper.central_claim: 把记忆系统的整个检索配置(视图数/融合模式/权重/上下文预算/答案风格/类别覆盖)暴露为结构化动作空间，由 LLM 诊断逐题失败日志提出调整，经带回退与探索保护的元分析器应用，自动从最小基线演化出更强检索策略(含‘全新配置维度’)，在 LoCoMo 与 MemBench 上超过最强基线并迁移到另一基准。
paper.claim_scope: 单机 SQLite 记忆库；LoCoMo-10(1,986 题)与 MemBench(28 样本)；GPT-4o/GPT-5.1；演化在带真值的评测题上离线进行。

provenance.notes: actual_model/session_id/receipt_ref: worker subagent has no accessible run receipt; not probed per contract.

rationale: 检索配置自演化有回退保护，但在带真值的同一评测集上优化并选最优轮，MemBench仅28样本，‘新维度/普适迁移’与自述字段约束矛盾，E.holdout近无效。

sections_read: Appendix A-F (formulations, algorithms, case study, prompts)

evidence.quote: We argue that truly adaptive memory requires co-evolution at two levels: the stored knowledge and the retrieval mechanism that queries it.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者主张：除存储内容外，检索机制本身也应演化。

evidence.quote: In each evolution round, the module reads per-question failure logs, identifies root causes, and proposes targeted configuration adjustments; a guarded meta-analyzer applies them with automatic revert-on-regression and explore-on-stagnation safeguards.
evidence.support_explanation: 机制：逐题失败日志→LLM 诊断→结构化配置调整→带回退/探索保护的元分析器应用。

evidence.quote: discovering effective retrieval strategies including entirely new configuration dimensions not present in the original action space.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者声称发现了原动作空间之外的全新配置维度。

evidence.quote: be a set of evaluation questions with ground-truth answers
evidence.support_explanation: 进化目标 F(θ;K,Q) 是在评测问题集 Q(带真值答案)上的平均得分——优化对象与评测对象是同一批题。

evidence.quote: After each evaluation round r r , the system writes a per-question raw log containing every question, prediction, ground-truth answer, score, and retrieved sources.
evidence.support_explanation: 诊断 LLM 读到每题的真值答案与得分(并见‘worst cases’样本)。

evidence.quote: The engine terminates when round-over-round improvement drops below ϵ \epsilon or the maximum round count R max R_{\max} is reached
evidence.support_explanation: 终止并返回 θ*=argmax_r f_r：最终配置按同一评测集的最高得分选出。

evidence.quote: This is how the evolution mechanism is self-expanding: the diagnosis LLM can propose entirely new parameters that were not in the original action space.
evidence.support_explanation: ‘自扩展’的断言。

evidence.quote: Fields MUST match RetrievalConfig field names exactly. Only include fields you want to change.
evidence.support_explanation: 与 E07 矛盾：诊断输出必须使用 RetrievalConfig 已有字段名，无法提出新参数。

evidence.quote: The RetrievalConfig dimensions exposed to the diagnosis LLM.
evidence.support_explanation: Table 7：预定义维度已含 enable_entity_swap、enable_query_decomposition、enable_answer_verification、reflection_rounds、answer_style(6 分支)、time_decay、per_category_overrides。‘发现’的实体替换/分解/验证实际是预置开关，θ0 中处于关闭。

evidence.quote: 9. LoCoMo prompt-surface flags are highest-ROI when their symptom matches; propose them early.
evidence.support_explanation: 诊断提示直接点名 LoCoMo 专用旋钮，与‘规则以失败模式而非基准书写’的说法不符。

evidence.quote: A regex classifier routes each Cat. 3 question to one of six subtypes
evidence.support_explanation: LoCoMo Cat.3 六子类正则分类与专用指令块(locomo_cat3_inferential_nuanced)是基准专用提示面。

evidence.quote: This question may deliberately swap person names.
evidence.support_explanation: Cat.5 提示直接写入对 LoCoMo 对抗类别的先验，并要求总是给出实质答案。

evidence.quote: 3. NEVER answer ’Unknown’, ’Not specified’, ’Not mentioned’. Even if context is indirect, pick the single most plausible answer from what IS mentioned.
evidence.support_explanation: 答案风格规则含格式约定(数字用阿拉伯数字、年份 YYYY、1–10 词)，直接迎合 token-F1，不属检索质量。

evidence.quote: Self-evolution trajectory on LoCoMo (single-backbone GPT-4o). Each round records the structured adjustment proposed by the diagnosis module and validated by the meta-analyzer.
evidence.support_explanation: Table 4：R0 30.5→R1 35.8(意图规划+RRF)→R2 34.8(回退)→R3 37.2→R4 38.5→R5 38.1→R6 45.4→R7 54.3(答案验证+超参扫描+上下文预算调优)。R6、R7 合计 +15.8pp，R7 含‘hyperparameter sweep’。

evidence.quote: Replacing the diagnosis module with random perturbations over the same action space costs
evidence.support_explanation: 随机扰动对照 44.67 vs 完整 54.3(−9.63)；单次运行，随机搜索仅作对照，无网格/贝叶斯/人工调参基线。

evidence.quote: Removing the three extraction guards (retries, chunk-splitting, coverage verification) is the single most damaging ablation
We report on the full LoCoMo-10 release: 10 conversations, 1,986 QA pairs.
evidence.support_explanation: LoCoMo 全量 1,986 题既用于进化也用于报告；MemBench 仅 28 个样本(7 类×2 主题×2 样本)，整体准确率 67.9%=19/28、57.1%=16/28。

evidence.quote: Cross-benchmark transfer (GPT-4o).
evidence.support_explanation: Table 5：基线 LoCoMo 0.305；C_L 0.543/MemBench 0.543；C_LM 0.593/0.792；C_M MemBench 0.679。MemBench 无未进化配置的参照；0.543 与 0.792 均不是 1/28 的整数倍(15.2/28、22.2/28)，与 Table 3 的 28 样本口径不符；C_L 在 MemBench 上 54.3% 低于 RecentMem/MemGPT 的 57.1%。

evidence.quote: (3) Positive rather than catastrophic transfer.
evidence.support_explanation: 迁移结论：C_LM 在 LoCoMo 上由 0.543 升至 0.593，是‘持续进化’而非未见任务上的冻结评估。

evidence.quote: Evolved configurations transfer across benchmarks with positive rather than catastrophic transfer, indicating that the self-evolution process captures universal retrieval principles rather than benchmark-specific heuristics.
evidence.support_explanation: ‘普适检索原则’的主张。

evidence.quote: Default values were chosen based on preliminary experiments on a held-out validation set (2 LoCoMo samples) and remained fixed for all reported results.
evidence.support_explanation: 默认超参只在 2 个 LoCoMo 样本上预调；这 2 个样本是否仍在报告集内未说明。

evidence.quote: LLM calls for extraction and diagnosis use GPT-5.1 via Azure OpenAI API. Answer generation uses GPT-4o for all categories.
evidence.support_explanation: 与 Table 2/3 的 ‘GPT-4o / GPT-5.1 两个骨干’口径冲突：抽取与诊断恒用 GPT-5.1；基线是否同待遇不明。

evidence.quote: A full 7-round evolution on one LoCoMo sample (200 QA, ∼ \sim 900 memories) completes in 25–35 min wall clock, dominated by QA evaluation LLM calls.
evidence.support_explanation: 只报墙钟：每样本 7 轮 25–35 分钟；无 token/金额、无基线可比预算，进化需要带真值题的反复完整评测。

evidence.quote: R2 illustrates the revert guard
evidence.support_explanation: R2 提案在整体 F1 上回退，元分析器自动回滚到 R1 配置(回退阈值 τ_rev=0.01)。该回退依据仍是同一评测集上的整体 F1。

evidence.quote: On LoCoMo we compare against six memory systems: MemVerse [ 15 ] , Mem0 [ 3 ] , Claude-Mem, A-MEM [ 34 ] , MemGPT [ 19 ] , and SimpleMem [ 13 ] .
evidence.support_explanation: 基线数值来源(转引或复现)、提示与抽取模型是否对齐均未说明。

evidence.quote: LoCoMo comparison (token-F1 and BLEU-1) across two LLM backbones.
evidence.support_explanation: Table 2：GPT-4o 总体 F1 EvolveMem .543 vs SimpleMem .432；对抗类 EvolveMem .936 低于 MemVerse .944；MultiHop F1 .316 低于 SimpleMem .318；GPT-5.1 总体 .572 vs .418。

evidence.quote: MemBench comparison (accuracy %) across two backbones.
evidence.support_explanation: Table 3：GPT-4o 总体 EvolveMem 67.9 vs RecentMem/MemGPT 57.1、MemBank 46.4、SCMem 39.3；Robustness 50.0 低于 MemBank 75.0；GPT-5.1 71.4 vs MemBank 64.3。
我们的核对：Algorithm 2 把‘自演化’放在会话流上线运行，而实验是在带真值的 QA 集上离线多轮演化后冻结；部署时无真值题则诊断输入不可得，文中未说明替代信号。

gap.author_gap: 现有记忆系统让存储内容演化，而评分函数、融合策略、上下文预算与答案生成策略在部署时保持冻结，不同问题类型需要不同检索策略。
gap.checked_gap: 被改变的固定对象是‘检索配置’：由人工调参变为失败日志驱动的自动配置搜索。问题合理，但被认为‘首个’的新颖性主要靠特征勾选；最近邻 MemEvolve(联合演化知识与记忆架构)、MemSkill、ADAS/AFlow 类架构搜索、DSPy 式优化器等未做同条件比较，且‘自动调检索超参’与 LLM 驱动数据库调参、自适应 RAG 的区别被一笔带过。
